readerCopy.body: An opportunity can expand once a less conventional choice stops being translated into language designed to make it sound ordinary. When Jupiter trines Lilith, expansion and autonomy reinforce each other, allowing a niche project, unusual career move, private preference, or nonstandard direction to find more support than expected. The ease does not require the rebellion to become larger for emphasis. The opening is useful because the actual choice can grow without first being disguised.
